$comment: Root ADR-0280. How 차세대 온비드 (KAMCO Onbid) public-auction data is fetched from data.go.kr, what a response must look like, and the call budget. The collector (`collect-data-go-kr-onbid` in services/foundation-outbox-publisher), the Silver load (infra/lakehouse/spark/jobs/data_go_kr_onbid.py) and their tests read this file; nothing else restates these values. The service key is the platform's DATA_GO_KR_SERVICE_KEY and is never written here or into Bronze (the request fingerprint drops it). Measured 2026-10-19: every list item carries a 19-digit ltnoPnu; about 78,400 real-estate items are open (pvctTrgtYn N about 61,600, Y about 16,800); one full item pass is about 95 calls and 137 MB of JSON, 8.8 MB gzipped.

result_codes.$comment: header.resultCode (or result.resultCode on an error body). 00 is rows; 03 (NODATA_ERROR) is a valid empty answer for a combination with no open items. Any other code refuses the run: a key, quota or parameter problem must not read as 'no items'.

daily_call_limit_per_api.$comment: Our own daily bound per API (KST day). Measured 2026-10-19: the gateway answers every one of the four list/result APIs with X-RateLimit-Limit 100000 (the key is an operating account) and the remaining count showed another user of the same key, so we take at most a fifth of it. The collector stops an API before it would pass this bound and records the stop; it never spreads one API's calls over another's quota. item_detail (getRlstDtlInf2, ADR-0296 §1) is the same gateway and key, bounded the same way until its own volume is measured. The item list's interval (item_list.every_hours) is set by storage cost, not by this bound.

property_division_codes.$comment: prptDivCd, a mandatory parameter of every list API (the provider's own meanings, swagger 2026-03-20). Every code is asked: a code with no open items costs one call and answers 03.

item_list.$comment: 물건목록 (data.go.kr 15157207). Only open rounds are listed: an item condition (cltrMngNo, pbctCdtnNo) leaves the list when its bidding ends, so a key absent from a complete pass is a closed round and is asked once at item_bid_result. A pass is complete only when every (prptDivCd, pvctTrgtYn) combination was read to its last page; an incomplete pass lands in Bronze but marks nothing removed. Every 3 hours, not every hour, because a full pass is about 8.8 MB gzipped and Bronze only grows: hourly would pass the owner's storage budget (perfectory-ops cost record), while the quota would allow it.

announcement_list.$comment: 공고목록 (data.go.kr 15157216). cltrTypeCd 0001 is real estate. The window is the 개찰일 range the request names.

announcement_bid_result_list.$comment: 공고 입찰결과목록 (data.go.kr 15157222), the announcements whose opening fell in the window.

item_bid_result.$comment: 물건 입찰결과상세 (data.go.kr 15157254), one call per closed item condition, oldest first; the rest wait for the next run. A 03 answer is recorded as asked (the provider has no result yet) and asked again after retry_after_hours, at most max_asks times. per_run_limit: 한 run 당 입찰결과 ask 상한 — daily_call_limit 만으론 한 run 이 하루치(2만)를 다 돌 수 있어, 밀린 백로그가 크면(2026-10-26 사고: ~7,600건) 한 run 이 request_spacing×수천 = 작업 시간제한을 초과해 죽고 커밋을 못 한다. 백로그는 여러 run 에 나눠 뺀다. 실측 후 상향.

item_detail.$comment: 물건상세 (data.go.kr 15157247, getRlstDtlInf2; ADR-0296 §1, ADR-0297). 열린 회차(open_items) 중 아직 상세를 받지 않은 것을 매 수집에서 daily 한도 안에서 받고, 받은 것은 state.detailed 로 기억해 다시 받지 않는다(끝난 회차는 open_items 에서 빠지며 detailed 에서도 지운다). 응답 body.items.item 에 사진 목록(potoUrlList[].urlAdr)·감정평가서 첨부(apslEvlClgList[].urlAdr)가 들어오고(둘 다 호스트 www.onbid.co.kr), 용도 대/중/소 이름(cltrUsgLclsCtgrNm 등)도 inline 이다. 그 바이너리 다운로드·R2 content-addressed 미러는 ADR-0296 Stage B(별도 PR). path 는 운영 서비스키 실호출(2026-10-26)로 확인한 값: OnbidRlstDtlSrvc2 다(OnbidRlstDtlInfSrvc2 는 게이트웨이 code 12 '해당 오픈API 서비스가 없거나 폐기됨'). 상세 수집 실패는 details_errored 로 격리되어 run 을 깨지 않는다. **per_run_limit: 한 run 에서 받는 상세 건수 상한** — 이게 없으면 열린 물건 수만 건을 한 run 에 다 받으려다 작업 systemd 시간제한(약 40분)을 넘겨 timeout 으로 죽고, 수집기는 끝에서 한꺼번에 커밋하므로 그 run 전체가 커밋 못 함(2026-10-26 사고). 전수 backfill 은 여러 run 에 나눠 진행. 안전 복구용으로 작게(50) 시작, 실제 run 시간 측정 후 상향.

media.$comment: 물건상세의 사진·감정평가서 바이너리를 KAMCO(url_host) 공개 URL 에서 받아 공용 content-addressed 저장소(ADR-0290 §7 / ADR-0296 §2, foundation-shared-kernel media.rs)에 object_prefix 아래 sha256/<해시>.<확장자> 로 한 번만 담는다(onbid_media.rs). 실물(2026-10-26): 사진=potoUrlList[].urlAdr, 감정평가서=apslEvlClgList[].urlAdr, 둘 다 www.onbid.co.kr. url_host 외 호스트는 받지 않는다(응답 변조·예상외 호스트로 임의 fetch 방지). 형식은 바이트 매직으로 판정하며(만료 링크의 HTML 오류 페이지는 걸러짐) 판정 실패는 미저장. daily_download_limit 는 '첫 수집 실측 먼저'를 위해 작게 시작하고, 용량을 잰 PR 이 올린다(루트 selection_archive_new_bytes_budget 0 시작 선례와 같은 방식). max_file_bytes 는 비정상적으로 큰 단일 파일이 적재를 깨지 않게 하는 안전밸브(루트: 5.89GB 단일 PUT 사고). 다운로드/저장 실패는 격리되어 수집 run 을 깨지 않는다. **1c 상향(2026-10-26 실측 반영)**: 10-26 15:08 UTC run 실측 = 20 시도 중 downloaded 18·deduplicated 1·skipped_unknown_format 1·errored 0, bytes 3,507,256(~190KB/장). R2 `read_object_sha256` 가 404(객체 없음)를 Err 로 보던 결함(#867)을 고친 뒤 저장이 정상화됐다(그 전엔 errored 20·downloaded 0). 이제 **per_run_limit(한 run 당 다운로드 상한) + daily_download_limit 상향**으로 ADR-0300 H(모든 수집 작업은 run당 상한을 선언)에 맞춘다: per_run_limit 가 한 run 의 벽시계를 bound(최악 = per_run_limit × download_timeout_seconds = 50×20s=1000s < 작업 40분 한도)하고, daily_download_limit 는 하루 총량을 bound 해 백로그를 여러 run 에 나눠 뺀다. 전량 backfill 은 실측을 더 쌓은 뒤 추가 상향/전용 경로로.

status_codes.$comment: pbctStatCd, the provider's meanings (swagger). Values only; a consumer maps them to its own words.

silver_load.$comment: What one Silver load may take (plan-silver-load-objects): Bronze objects of item_list and item_bid_result that no commit of their table records, landed within window_days, oldest first, at most max_objects per table. The window stays shorter than the snapshot retention (lakehouse-maintenance.contract.json retain_days, refused otherwise): an expired snapshot takes its load record with it. A day of item passes (8) and results (24) fits one run.

pnu.$comment: ADR-0280 §3: the provider's ltnoPnu is the key, its 11th digit read through provider_ledger_kind_digits. A value Pnu::parse would refuse (not 19 ASCII digits, or a 대장구분 digit outside this list) keeps pnu null and its raw text in ltno_pnu_raw. The Silver load reads these values; a test in lakehouse-domain asserts they are exactly what foundation_shared_kernel::Pnu::parse accepts.

provider_ledger_kind_digits.$comment: ltnoPnu writes the 11th digit in the building-register hub dialect (0 ordinary, 1 mountain), not the standard 1/2. Measured on the first load (2026-10-19): of 7,629 distinct PNUs with 0, none is a current parcel as written and 7,107 are after 0 -> 1; of 938 with 1, 341 as written and 931 after 1 -> 2. The Silver load converts with this map before the Pnu::parse check; a digit outside it keeps pnu null. A lakehouse-domain test holds it equal to foundation_shared_kernel::standard_pnu_from_hub_register_codes, the dialect's one definition (root ADR-0023).
